mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% and the CPI index exceeds 325, it signals a dual tightening cycle that increases risk-free rates and inflation expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 325, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100k per month, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND PAYEMS > 100000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) compresses the equity risk premium by signaling strong consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a weakening economy that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) is below 1500, it signals a deepening economic slowdown that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 325, it signals persistent inflation that increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 325, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.
